scenario: asking for help with hotels & accommodation
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Help With Hotels and Accommodation
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: hotels & accommodation — asking for help with hotels & accommodation
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for help with hotels & accommodation; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr James to help her find a hotel nearby.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nhờ anh James giúp tìm khách sạn gần đây.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: James, can you help me find a hotel nearby?
turns.vietnamese: James này, anh giúp tôi tìm khách sạn gần đây được không?

turns.speaker: Mr James
turns.english: Yes, there is a good one close by.
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ, gần đây có một khách sạn tốt.
